proposal.hypothesis: For non-tautological clauses with1<=k<=64, let P_k(j) be the observed clause-frequency distribution of j positive literals conditional on arity k; let p be positive literal fraction in this eligible population. f=sum_k P(k)*KL(P_k || Binomial(k,p)). Degenerate p=0/1 is defined by its exact limiting distribution.
